brief:
The Ministry of Public Works and Housing reviewed its interventions across recovery, reconstruction, and emergency response operations in Gaza and northern West Bank areas, according to Maan Wire. The ministry assessed the scope of its work across both territories, focusing on infrastructure restoration and immediate humanitarian needs.

The review covered ongoing projects addressing damage from recent conflict and displacement, with the ministry accounting for resources directed toward both reconstruction priorities and urgent relief measures in the two regions.
title: Public Works ministry details Gaza reconstruction and emergency response efforts
